Independent from-definition computation reconstructed 21 incidences, 24 perfect matchings, eight edge one-factorizations, all 336 automorphisms, and full character χ and factorization permutation character π on each element. Irreducible inner products give H4≅Q[8 one-factorizations]⊕W8=1⊕7⊕8. The mathematics is correct but the module classification is not original.
